lines.text: Anthropic files public S-1 for Nasdaq ANT; H1 revenue $16.3B, net loss mostly non-cash
OpenAI ships GPT-6.1 Terra at $1/$5; AA Index 48 (max); Terminal-Bench 4.0 lab claim 50.3%
Meta launches ~$95B equity plan for AI infra; ~$35B underwritten now, $60B ATM later

feed.headline: Anthropic files its public S-1 and plans to list on Nasdaq as ANT
feed.why: Share count and price range are still blank. This is the first public look at Claude's parent as a prospective public company.

feed.headline: Anthropic S-1: $16.3B first-half revenue; $80.7B net loss, mostly non-cash
feed.why: Operating loss narrowed to $693M. About $72.4B of the net loss is fair-value accounting on convertibles and related instruments.

feed.headline: Anthropic S-1: up to $120.5B with SpaceXAI through 2029 for Nvidia GPU compute
feed.why: About $3.1B a month once capacity is fully delivered, expected Dec 2026. Cancellation needs 90 days' notice.

feed.headline: OpenAI ships GPT-6.1 Terra at $1/$5; Terminal-Bench 4.0 lab claim 50.3%
feed.why: API id gpt-6.1-terra. Live in ChatGPT Work and Codex. OpenAI still points hardest coding to Sol or Astra.

feed.headline: Artificial Analysis scores GPT-6.1 Terra (max) 48 on the Intelligence Index, #25 of 221
feed.why: Independent check. Lab charts for Agents' Last Exam and OSWorld stay marketing until AA or Epoch confirm them.

feed.headline: AWS: GPT-6.1 Terra is generally available on Amazon Bedrock
feed.why: Enterprise buyers can call Terra through Bedrock APIs or point ChatGPT Work and Codex at Bedrock.

feed.headline: Meta launches ~$95B equity plan for AI infra; ~$35B underwritten, $60B ATM later
feed.why: Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom signaled interest in up to $5B of the common offering. 2026 capex guide is $135–145B.

feed.headline: LiteLLM said it would disclose a second, already-fixed security flaw today
feed.why: Named in its Oct 21 malware post. No new advisory was on the LiteLLM blog at this card's publish time.

feed.headline: Mistral Large 4 open weights are due by the end of October
feed.why: Large 4 is still API preview only. No weights or license posted yet.

feed.headline: Moonshot says Kimi K3.1 Pro weights come by 4 Nov
feed.why: API is live; Artificial Analysis already ranks the model near the top of its Index.
